about_the_game:
Take on the role of Agent Maxim Powell, a veteran New Arkham policewoman who responds to a call from Headquarters to address a problem with mutants in a remote area of the city.

Three people find themselves in the middle of the brawl with the mutants, choosing the right options will change the ending of the game, and with it, the scenes to unlock.

The mindless mutants can spread their mutation through the air and fluids, but the police officer has plenty of time before that happens to carry out the only way to avoid mutations, the Amplexus protocol.

Aim, shoot and reload.

Find out why three men have ended up in the cemetery surrounded by mutants.

Dare with 8 stages of increasing difficulty in a replayable shooter and get the reward to decide how Agent Powell deals with the Amplexus protocol.

Enjoy annihilating 9 different types of mutants with three different weapons.

All the graphics of the game have been designed by hand, (using Procreate, but by hand...).

Discover music by talented artists specially chosen to generate a unique atmosphere.

Unlock 12 enticing scenes about the famous Amplexus protocol of New Arkham.

A mix between a classic shooter and a visual novel for adults, with a short duration and a simple gameplay. The game has an option to enjoy the story and most of the scenes without shooting, for those looking for a more narrative experience.

The game as well comes with difficulty modes, with unique scene rewards.

Playable with just one had.
